outcome_at_stake: Admin's willingness to move the team onto Ledgerly
why_disproportionate: Admins say they gate the whole team's start on this one invoice (stated intent). Among accounts that attempted a sync, a first synced invoice within the pre-specified 7 days goes with 55% vs 31% meeting the threshold, and the gap holds within seat bands (about 140 excess failures per 1,000 entrants as an upper bound); not stratified by ledger vendor or compared with reference nodes, and not tested by intervention
failure_consequence: Admin keeps checking the ledger by hand and delays invites; team stays on the old way

outcome_at_stake: Continuity of set-up when the decision leaves the account
why_disproportionate: The mapping decision passes to a person outside the account with no access, context or deadline, and Ledgerly loses sight of the journey; the length of the pause is not measured
failure_consequence: Set-up pauses for an unmeasured period, or the admin guesses and the guess fails at posting

outcome_at_stake: Teammates' first-week experience and the admin's control over what is sent
why_disproportionate: Rules set after teammates start reverse permissions mid-work; the first thing a teammate meets is an unexplained block. Excess failures per 1,000 entrants cannot be computed until MET-0014 is baselined and linked to the outcome
failure_consequence: Teammates revert to the old way or work around approvals; admin tightens rules further
